testcase.name: Scenario: Switch to Home while the Modify expansion is pinned: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:580:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch to Home while the Modify expansion is pinned ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is visible ✔ And the Modify additional command area is pinned and remains open after a click in empty viewport space ✔ When the user selects the Home document tab ✔ Then Home is displayed and the Modify additional command area is no longer visible ✔ When the user returns to the part document tab ✔ Then the 3D Model ribbon is visible and the Modify additional command area is closed ✔ When the user opens the Modify additional command area ✔ And the user clicks an empty area of the viewport ✔ Then the Modify additional command area closes
